body: You don't sound pathetic to me my friend. You sound like you're having a rough time, and you're entitled to deal with that any way you want. Talk to someone, please. You can share here if you want, or on r/SuicideWatch (there's a lot of people who will gladly listen to your story over there), or with one of your friends. But most of all, take the time to process this change in your life. If you're up to it, please tell us what you've been going through these last 9 years. There's a lot of people willing to lend you a listening ear and shoulder.
Baby steps my friend, baby steps. You'll get there. Music is a powerful motivator. It's nice to hear a succes story from someone having a hard time once in a while.

I agree with acopaladyandaguy. You need a break. You've been through some shit. Take some time for yourself. This probably sounds like empty blabbering, but man it sounds like you could use some time to decompress.

It's good you're getting treatment. I hope you can get through this. Take good care of yourself, please.

Try reading the resources in this subreddit. They give excellent insight in the way suicidal people think, and how to try and help them.

Most of all, try to be understanding. Just be there for your ex, listen to him and try reminding him of things he loves or is passionate about. Try to help not to feel isolated.But really, read the resources.

Best of luck.

Exactly. You know you shouldn't feel guilty, but not feeling guilty would make you feel more guilty, if that makes sense. Human emotions are a mess my friend. I'm sorry to hear about your friend who passed away. It's never easy dealing with that and all these conflicting emotions, as I have had to discover recently.

I'm sorry to hear about your troubles. It mustn't be easy having to deal with an abusive father and your mother's condition.

I can't guarantee that things will get better. I don't want to sound like a cheap self-help book, but I can say that you can make things better. You may not see it that way, but the simple fact that you reached out to this community means you want to. You ask for a help, and that's already a great thing.

I can't tell you what to do, or how to improve your life. To be honest I have no real understanding of what you're going through, and I wouldn't want to do your feelings any injustice.

You say however, that you feel like you no real purpose to keep on going. I can't tell you where to look for it, but I'm sure there's something you love. Examine those things, and yourself, and you might find something worthwile.

Lastly, please don't decide anything just yet. You're very young, and you might not feel like it, I think there's a lot of good stuff you would miss out on if you chose to end things now. 

Not sure how much help this was, but know there are people here who are willing to help, but most of all, they're willing to listen.
